violet-900.$description: Violet 900 — Dominant brand dark — nav text, dark section backgrounds, primary copy on light surfaces, icon strokes, filled navigation pills. This is the brand's gravity: wherever you need weight or authority, you reach for Violet 900

lilac-300.$description: Lilac 300 — Brand accent — primary action fills, active states, chart highlights and accent text on deep violet. Never as text on light backgrounds

violet-800.$description: Violet 800 — Secondary deep violet for card surfaces, supporting iconography, and tonal depth on dark sections where Violet 900 is too heavy

violet-600.$description: Violet 600 — Mid violet for accents that must read as text on light surfaces: labels, rules, small highlights. 6.4:1 on white

lilac-50.$description: Lilac 50 — Pale lilac wash for soft highlight surfaces, tinted card backgrounds, nav hover states. A whisper of the brand violet for low-emphasis containers

blue-800.$description: Blue 800 — Status: information, "opened". A status color, never a brand color

red-600.$description: Red 600 — Status: error, "overdue", destructive actions. A status color, never a brand color

neutral-700.$description: Neutral 700 — Primary text, body copy, dense UI — slightly warm black that feels softer than pure #000 against white

neutral-950.$description: Neutral 950 — Display headlines, high-contrast headings, pure-black moments in nav and hero. Slightly violet-tinted black, not neutral gray

neutral-500.$description: Neutral 500 — Muted secondary text, placeholder copy, icon strokes, input borders. The mid-gray that recedes. Darkened to 4.7:1 on white so secondary text stays AA

neutral-600.$description: Neutral 600 — Supporting body text, helper labels, subdued iconography. One step darker than Neutral 500 for slightly more emphasis

neutral-100.$description: Neutral 100 — Card surfaces, section dividers, subtle panel backgrounds on the white canvas. Violet-tinted off-white, not pure neutral

white.$description: White — Page canvas, inverted card surfaces, button text on lilac fill

green-700.$description: Green 700 — Status: success, "paid", "approved", "active". Status colors did not move with the brand: green stays green

green-50.$description: Green 50 — Status wash behind success tags

neutral-200.$description: Neutral 200 — Hairlines and dividers, slightly violet

role.$description: LES RÔLES — ce que la factory lit pour habiller les livrables Office du projet (Word, PowerPoint). Chaque rôle est un alias vers une couleur de la palette, ou une valeur hex. Changer le design system d'un projet, c'est changer ses rôles dans son tokens.json de C1.4 : un rôle absent reprend celui du départ standard.

accent.$description: Accent lisible en texte sur fond clair : filets, étiquettes, repères

texte-sombre.$description: Texte sur fond sombre — 10,7:1 sur violet 900

texte-discret-sombre.$description: Texte discret sur fond sombre — 5,4:1 sur violet 900

inter.$description: Body, UI, labels, and sub-headings across the entire product. The 700 weight handles mid-tier headings (36–45px), 500–600 for subheadings and labels, 400 for body and captions. Inter does the quiet work while Wise Sans shouts.

display.$description: Display headlines — Wise Sans weight 900, tightly tracked (-0.03em at 89–105px). The block-letter voice of the system: hero, section openers, campaign moments. Used sparingly. Substitute when Wise Sans is not installed: Inter 900 with -0.04em tracking.

monospace.$description: monospace — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

micro.$description: Micro — mentions, horodatages, compteurs. Le plus petit texte autorisé.

caption.$description: Légende — aides de champ, métadonnées, texte secondaire dense.

body-sm.$description: Corps réduit — texte d'interface courant, libellés de formulaires, cartes.

body.$description: Corps — texte de lecture par défaut, en Neutral 700 sur White.

body-lg.$description: Corps large — chapô, accroche de section, chiffre mis en avant.

subheading.$description: Sous-titre — titre de bloc ou de carte majeure.

heading-sm.$description: Titre réduit — titre de section secondaire.

heading-lg.$description: Titre large — ouverture majeure, en blocs serrés. Voix d'affichage : Wise Sans 900 (repli Inter 900).

display.$description: Affichage — le titre du héros, une fois par page au plus. Voix d'affichage : Wise Sans 900 (repli Inter 900).

base.$description: Surface level 0: Page canvas — the default background for all content sections

subtle.$description: Surface level 1: Card surfaces, soft panels, and section backgrounds on the white canvas

tinted.$description: Surface level 2: Tinted highlight surfaces — pale lilac wash for accent containers and hover states

accent.$description: Surface level 3: Active surface — selected tabs, primary CTA fill, emphasis zones

inverse.$description: Surface level 4: Inverted surface — dark section backgrounds, nav, high-contrast blocks
